description: One token in about 2 KB: latest price, valuation, revenue and flows, 7- and 30-day changes, revenue_figures (the 30-day annualized pace AND the real last-12-months revenue, P/S on both, one-line notes on how each is formed), health score with its six pillar scores and verdict, supply unlocks, lens, and data-quality counts. Prefer this over tc_get_token.
name: tc_get_token_digest
